# Orangeville Drywalling

> Drywall installation, finishing and repair booking service for Orangeville and Dufferin County, Ontario, focused on basement apartments under the Town of Orangeville's 2025 additional residential unit rules, finished basements and additions, drywall repair, popcorn ceiling removal and Level 4 and Level 5 finishing.

Basement apartments (additional residential units): drywall built as the fire separation shown on the approved drawings, continuous at ducts, bulkheads and pot lights; Orangeville allows up to three units on a fully serviced lot, maximum two bedrooms per additional unit, 1.2 m clear entrance path, one extra parking space per unit, building permit required. Finished basements and additions: boarding, taping and finishing on new framing, planned around settlement in newer houses. Drywall repair and patching: holes, stress cracks, nail pops, water-damaged ceilings after ice damming, with wet board cut out and the source fixed first. Popcorn ceiling removal after a lab asbestos test, by scrape and skim or overlay. Taping, mudding and finishing to Level 4 or Level 5. Service area: Orangeville, Mono, Amaranth, Shelburne, Grand Valley, Erin and Caledon Village. Permits: Town of Orangeville Building Division (building@orangeville.ca, 519-941-0440 ext. 2228) for the town; Dufferin County Building Services for Amaranth, East Garafraxa, Grand Valley, Melancthon, Mono, Mulmur and Shelburne. Shelburne has a temporary pause on new accessory unit permits that need wastewater capacity. Written quote after a site visit. No published fixed prices, no reviews, no company history.
